correctness.rationale: Exact unitary Fourier model and cyclic measure are verified against the 2026 primary full text. The rank-one secular equation is reconstructed by solving (z-C)f=tau<f,e>e. A beta integral proves the sech² characteristic function, and signed Laplace transforms lead to the three stated G(z) formulas. The second derivative of t/(e^t-1) is positive by an explicit H,H',H'' calculation, establishing strict endpoint-to-endpoint monotonicity. Half-integer inverse-square sums give the two pi² endpoint values. λ=0 and λ=2 are treated directly and correctly, essential spectrum by compact-perturbation invariance, simple off-circle roots by nonvanishing derivative, and local λ=0 slope by Taylor series. An independently implemented direct Fourier spectral quadrature matches all three Laplace forms on sample values; finite tests are not treated as infinite proofs.
